"6ab461e0-664b-50c8-abbc-e8ab24be4cdb" :question/worked-solution "Collect the common factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}
&\sqrt{5}\cos^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)-\sqrt{5}\sin^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)\\&=\sqrt{5}\left(\cos^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)-\sin^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

Use the cosine double-angle formula:

$$
\cos^2 x-\sin^2 x=\cos(2x)
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
\cos^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)-\sin^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)&=\cos\left(2\cdot \frac{5\pi}{12}\right)\\&=\cos\left(\frac{5\pi}{6}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

Keep the outside factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sqrt{5}\left(\cos^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)-\sin^2\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)\right)&=\sqrt{5}\cos\left(\frac{5\pi}{6}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "6ab461e0-664b-50c8-abbc-e8ab24be4cdb" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "6ab461e0-664b-50c8-abbc-e8ab24be4cdb" :question/answer-fields
